title: Characterize cargohold authorization and parser/storage edge contracts on the pinned reference

acceptance_criteria.description: Real pinned Haskell observations characterize federation UUID/domain and legacy OTR requester handling, plus multipart quirks needed for the Go parser.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual isolated reference requests, seeded S3 metadata/bytes, positive/negative controls and immutable image/config/tool identities; no candidate or security disposition invented.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reference characterization remains isolated and preserves original assertions, sources and defaults.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Bounded request/artifact handling and owned cleanup, focused tool and migration checks, source-derived case expectations reviewed separately from candidate work.

evidence.command: Real pinned Haskell authorization/multipart characterization: 20 source-derived positive/negative controls, actual S3 metadata/bytes, valid signed Host downloads and partial-object effects. Reference-only, candidate null/parity_verified false. Exact captured code/image/config/binary identities retained; cargo binary equals prior compiled-suite preflight.

51 parity/reference boundary tests, state/scope/whitespace checks pass; 32 migration unit tests reused for unchanged validator inputs. Docker inspection confirms no owned reference containers/networks remain. Original Haskell sources/fixtures/defaults/e2e assertions unchanged; reserved contract not edited.

handoff: 20 real reference observations retained. Confirmed federation matching UUID bypasses token irrespective of foreign origin; different UUID controls enforce token. Legacy OTR redirects/downloads for either requester when valid stored user exists. Parser accepts unequal delimiters, wrong MD5, length suffix/missing trailer; incomplete data returns 400 after persisting a completed partial object. User contract/security disposition requested for federation behavior under existing guardrails; no exception, full contract approval or candidate parity claimed. Goal remains active; other safe preparation may proceed.
